group.label: Connection
group.comment: Connect this store to your TackQuote account. Quote requests and every B2B feature below need a saved API key.

field.label: Enable TackQuote
field.comment: Turns the storefront "Request a Quote" button and quote-request calls on or off.

field.label: TackQuote API Base URL
field.comment: Default is https://api.tackquote.com/v1. Include the /v1 path, no trailing slash. Change only for a staging/custom deployment.

field.label: TackQuote API Key
field.comment:
Filled in for you by Connect with TackQuote above, or paste one: create an API key in TackQuote under Settings > Developer > API Keys with the quotes:write scope, then paste it here. Stored encrypted using Magento's crypt key.
Until a key is saved the storefront quote button stays hidden.

field.label: Verify
field.comment: Save the settings above first, then test.

group.label: Storefront: quote-only store (B2B catalog)
group.comment: Turn the store into a catalog where shoppers request a quote instead of checking out, for everyone or for the shoppers you choose. Off by default.

field.label: Enable quote-only mode
field.comment:
Turns the whole storefront into a B2B catalog: Add to Cart and checkout are refused by the server, and shoppers request a quote instead. This is enforced in PHP, not by hiding buttons, so a crafted request cannot get around it.
Existing carts are not emptied. They can still be viewed and emptied; they simply cannot grow or be checked out, and they work normally again the moment you switch this off.
Creating orders from the Admin (Sales > Orders > Create New Order) is unaffected, and so is TackQuote turning an accepted quote into a real order. The same refusals apply to shoppers using the REST and GraphQL APIs; your admin and integration tokens are exempt.
To make only some products quote-only, leave this off and set Quote only (TackQuote) to Yes on those products.
Requires a saved API key above — without one no quote button can render, so quote-only mode stays inactive rather than leaving your storefront with no way to buy AND no way to ask.

field.label: Applies to
field.comment:
Who sees the quote-only storefront. "Guests only" is the usual B2B setup: the public gets a catalog, and customers who have signed in keep a normal cart and checkout.
"Everyone except approved wholesale accounts" keeps the cart only for a signed-in customer whose wholesale application you have approved in TackQuote (matched by the customer's email address, re-checked every 5 minutes). If TackQuote cannot be reached the customer is treated as not approved and sees the quote-only storefront. Magento does not confirm a customer's email on its own: turn on Customer Configuration > Create New Account Options > Require Emails Confirmation so nobody can sign up with an approved buyer's address.

field.label: Show "Price on request" instead of prices
field.comment: For the shoppers quote-only mode applies to, product pages and category, search and related-product tiles show "Price on request" instead of the price (and no account price or volume table). Everyone else, the cart, the admin and the quote request you receive in TackQuote keep Magento's prices. This changes what is displayed; it does not remove prices from the product data feeds, REST or GraphQL. Products that are quote-only on their own (the product's "Quote only (TackQuote)" setting) keep their price and show "Available on quote".

field.label: Customer groups
field.comment: Used only when "Applies to" is set to selected customer groups. NOT LOGGED IN is a real group here and can be selected on its own — that is equivalent to "Guests only".

group.label: Storefront: styling
group.comment: How the quote buttons, the quote list launcher and the B2B prices look. Everything here is optional: with the defaults they use your theme's own buttons and colors.

field.label: Accent color
field.comment: Optional. A hex color such as #1e73be. Repaints the quote buttons, the quote list launcher and the B2B account price, with black or white text, whichever is easier to read. Leave empty to use your theme's colors.

field.label: Button style
field.comment: Filled: solid buttons, like your theme's. Outlined: a border and no fill, in the accent color when one is set.

field.label: Quote list launcher position
field.comment: The floating button that opens the shopper's quote list. Shown once a product is in the list, when "Show Add to Quote button" is on.

field.label: Launcher distance from the edges (px)
field.comment: From the bottom and side of the window, 0 to 200. Default 20.

field.label: Launcher text
field.comment: Leave empty for "Quote list". At most 40 characters.

field.label: Custom CSS
field.comment: Optional CSS added to every storefront page after this module's own styles, for example .tackquote-request-btn { border-radius: 0; }. At most 10,000 characters. The < character is not allowed.

group.label: B2B pricing: what signed-in customers see
group.comment: Shows a signed-in customer what TackQuote holds for their account on the product page, read live from TackQuote and never stored in the page cache. Display only: the cart and checkout charge Magento's own prices unless "Charge account prices in the cart" in the next group is on. The customer's email address, the product SKU and the store currency are sent to TackQuote to find the account.

field.label: Show account price
field.comment:
"Your account price" under the product price, with the store price struck through when the account price is lower. Shown only for a price TackQuote holds for this customer's account, and not on configurable, bundle or grouped products.
The cart charges this price only when "Charge account prices in the cart" under B2B Checkout is on; otherwise checkout uses Magento's own price, and the shopper is told so beside it.

field.label: Show volume pricing table
field.comment: The customer's quantity breaks (quantity and unit price). Like the account price, these are charged in the cart only when "Charge account prices in the cart" under B2B Checkout is on, and are not shown on configurable, bundle or grouped products.

field.label: Show order limits notice
field.comment: "Order between X and Y units of this product." A notice only: the cart enforces the limit when "Enforce order limits" under B2B Checkout is on.

field.label: Show buyer group badge
field.comment: The name of the customer's TackQuote buyer group.

field.label: Only for these customer groups
field.comment: Leave empty to show B2B data to every signed-in customer. TackQuote finds the account by the customer's email address, and Magento does not confirm an email address a customer types at sign-up or changes later unless account confirmation is on. Selecting the groups you place approved trade customers in keeps a new account that typed someone else's address from seeing that buyer's prices. NOT LOGGED IN is never shown B2B data.

group.label: B2B pricing: cart and checkout
group.comment: Makes the cart and checkout follow TackQuote for signed-in customers in the customer groups chosen in the previous group (empty: every signed-in customer). Guests, the admin order editor and API integrations are never affected. The customer's email address, the cart's SKUs and quantities and the cart currency are sent to TackQuote.

field.label: Charge account prices in the cart
field.comment:
Each cart line is charged the price TackQuote holds for this customer's account at that quantity, asked for the whole cart in one request and asked again when the order is placed. Only a price from the customer's price book, in the cart's currency, is charged; anything else keeps Magento's price. Applies to simple, virtual and downloadable products, not to configurable or bundle lines.
Not applied when catalog prices are entered including tax (Stores > Configuration > Sales > Tax), because TackQuote prices are net. If TackQuote cannot be reached when the order is placed, the store's price is charged and the order notes it.

field.label: Enforce order limits
field.comment: Refuses adding to the cart, changing a quantity, or placing an order that breaks the minimum or maximum quantity TackQuote sets for a product, with the same wording as the order limits notice. Order total limits are checked when the order is placed. If TackQuote cannot be reached, nothing is refused.

group.label: Orders: accepted quote checkout
group.comment: When a buyer accepts a quote in TackQuote, the buyer portal can send them to this store with a checkout link. The store then fills the cart with the quoted products at the quoted prices, quantities locked, and the order is linked back to the quote.

field.label: Open accepted quotes in the checkout
field.comment: Opening the link replaces the shopper's cart with the quote (a signed-in customer's own cart, or a guest's). Other products cannot be added beside it, and removing one quoted line removes the quote. The quote's currency must be the store's base and display currency, and catalog prices must be entered excluding tax. The store must use https. Works in quote-only mode: an accepted quote is the one checkout it allows.

group.label: Storefront: quote buttons
group.comment: Where shoppers can ask for a quote. These buttons create quote requests in TackQuote; they never change the cart or checkout.

field.label: Show quote button on product pages
field.comment: When enabled, shoppers see a "Request a Quote" button on the product view page. Submitting it creates a quote request in TackQuote — it does not add to cart or affect checkout.

field.label: Show "Add to Quote" button
field.comment: Lets shoppers collect several products into a quote list and submit them as one request. The list is held in the browser and never touches the Magento cart, so stock, cart totals and checkout are unaffected.

field.label: Show on category and search results
field.comment: Adds "Add to Quote" to product listings, so a buyer can build a large request without opening every product page. Products with required options (configurable, bundle) link to the product page instead, since a quote needs the chosen variant.

group.label: Storefront: quote page, cart button and attachments
group.comment: More ways to build and send a quote request. The quote page and the cart button need "Show Add to Quote button" in the previous group.

field.label: Enable the quote page
field.comment: Adds a full page at /tackquote/quote showing the shopper's quote list, where quantities can be changed and a message added before sending, and a link to it from the quote list. No CMS page is needed.

field.label: Ask for a target price per product
Show a quote button on the cart page
field.comment: Copies the products and quantities in the shopper's cart into their quote list. The cart itself is not changed. Bundle products and products with custom options are left out and named, because a quote needs them chosen on their product page.

field.label: Allow attachments on quote requests
field.comment:
Shoppers can attach up to 3 files (PDF, JPEG or PNG, 5 MB each) to a quote request. Each file is checked by this store, then sent to TackQuote with its file name; nothing is saved in Magento.
Shown once TackQuote confirms it accepts files, checked by Magento cron every 5 minutes.

group.label: Forms: wholesale and net terms applications
group.comment: Adds tabs to My Account where a signed-in customer applies for a wholesale account or for net terms and sees where the application stands. Applications go to TackQuote for your review. The customer's email address and Magento customer ID are sent to TackQuote with each application.

field.label: Show "Wholesale account" tab
field.comment: The application form you built in TackQuote, including file uploads. After applying, the tab shows whether the application is being reviewed, approved or declined.

field.label: Wholesale form slug
field.comment: Which TackQuote wholesale form to show. Leave empty for your default form.

field.label: Show "Net terms" tab
field.comment: A net terms application, and the customer's approved terms and credit limit once you approve them in TackQuote.

group.label: Forms: pay on net terms (checkout)
group.comment: A checkout payment method shown only to a signed-in customer you approved for net terms in TackQuote, when their available credit covers the order in the order's currency. The order is placed as Pending; collect payment by invoice. Requires the "Net terms" approval to be linked to the customer's Magento account, which happens when you approve their application from this store.

field.label: Ask for a purchase order number
field.comment: An optional field under this payment method. The number is saved on the order and sent to TackQuote with it.

group.label: Buyer groups: rules for signed-in customers
group.comment: Rules keyed on the customer's TackQuote buyer group code, read from TackQuote when it is needed and kept for 60 seconds per customer. The customer's email address (and, where TackQuote supports it, the Magento customer ID) is sent to TackQuote to find the account. Rules use group CODES (for example GOLD), compared without regard to case. @GUESTS means everybody outside a group: guests, customers TackQuote places in no group, and customers outside the groups selected below. The admin and integrations (TackQuote's own quote conversion included) are never affected.

field.label: Only for these customer groups
field.comment: Leave empty to ask TackQuote about every signed-in customer. TackQuote finds the account by email address, and Magento does not confirm an address unless account confirmation is on. Selecting the groups you put trade customers in keeps a new account that typed someone else's address from getting that buyer's group. Customers outside the selection count as @GUESTS.

field.label: Hide categories by buyer group
field.comment: Hidden categories, and the products in them, leave the menu, category and search listings; their pages answer "page not found" and their products cannot be added to the cart. Child categories are hidden with their parent.

field.label: Categories hidden from groups
field.comment: One category per line: category ID: CODE, CODE, for example 12: RETAIL, @GUESTS hides category 12 from the RETAIL group and from everybody outside a group. The category ID is shown in Catalog > Categories.

field.label: Hide when the buyer group is unknown
field.comment: When TackQuote cannot be reached, a signed-in customer's group is unknown. No: the categories are shown. Yes: every category hidden from any group is hidden. Guests are always @GUESTS and need no lookup.

field.label: Restrict payment and shipping methods by buyer group
field.comment: A method with no line below stays available to everyone. A method with a line is available only to the groups it names. If the lines would leave a cart with no payment method or no shipping method, every method stays available and the store log says so.

field.label: Payment methods by group
field.comment: One method per line: method code: CODE, CODE, for example checkmo: TRADE, GOLD or purchaseorder: TRADE.

field.label: Shipping methods by group
field.comment: One line per carrier or rate: carrier code: CODE (for example freeshipping: GOLD) or carrier_method: CODE (for example tablerate_bestway: TRADE). A rate's own line wins over its carrier's.

field.label: Restrict when the buyer group is unknown
field.comment: When TackQuote cannot be reached. No: restricted methods stay available, so an outage does not stop anyone paying. Yes: they are withheld. A customer TackQuote places in no group never gets a restricted method.

field.label: Shipping discounts by buyer group
field.comment: Only customers TackQuote places in a group get a discount. Applied after the restrictions above.

field.label: Shipping discount per group
field.comment: One group per line: GOLD: percent=15 (15% off every shipping rate), GOLD: percent=15 | flatrate, tablerate (those carriers only), TIER2: free (shipping costs nothing), or TIER3: free_only (show only the rates that already cost nothing, when there is one).

field.label: Apply TackQuote tax exemptions
field.comment: When TackQuote marks the buyer tax exempt, the cart and checkout charge the customer tax class below instead of the group's. The customer's group is not changed. An outage, or no answer, charges tax as usual. TackQuote sends an exemption only for a customer it has linked to this store's customer account (an approved wholesale or credit application made from this store), never for an email match alone.

field.label: Customer tax class for tax-exempt buyers
field.comment: Create a customer tax class that no tax rule uses (Stores > Tax Rules) and choose it here. Catalog prices shown including tax are not changed; the cart and checkout charge no tax.

field.label: Set the customer group from the buyer group
field.comment: On sign-in, and at most every 5 minutes after, a customer whose TackQuote group is listed below is moved to that customer group. Only customers in the website's default group, or in a group this setting put them in, are moved; when TackQuote stops listing them they go back to the group they came from. Every change is written to the store log.

field.label: Customer group per buyer group
field.comment: One group per line: CODE: customer group ID, for example GOLD: 4. The ID is shown in Customers > Customer Groups. A customer group can carry its own prices and tax class, so check "Only for these customer groups" above.
